events.name: Bash
events.head: List intake and features pipeline files and existing cross references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; ls -la feedback-intake tasks/features 2>&1 | head -60; wc -l feedback-intake/*.py tasks/features/*.py 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "features\|T-153" feedback-intake/*.py | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read both stores, server ingest, triage and tests
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; cat tasks/features/reqstore.py; echo ------; cat feedback-intake/store.py; echo -----; cat feedback-intake/server.py | sed -n 1,60p; echo ----; cat feedback-intake/triage.py | sed -n 20,76p; echo; cat feedback-intake/test_intake.py; ls tasks/features/data; cat tasks/features/test_features.py | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show the rest of the saved output

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how the features pipeline uses its store and what data exists
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; grep -n "reqstore\.\|ingest_queue\|def \|sys.argv" tasks/features/seed.py tasks/features/weekly.py tasks/features/score.py tasks/features/test_features.py | cut -c1-220; ls tasks/features/data; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read weekly run, seed and the server routes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; sed -n 1,30p tasks/features/weekly.py | cut -c1-200; sed -n 36,48p tasks/features/seed.py | cut -c1-200; sed -n 70,135p feedback-intake/server.py | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wire the feed into the server, add a test, run both test suites

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run a fed feature through the weekly scoring job on a scratch copy, then commit
events.input: $ T=$(mktemp -d) && cp tasks/features/data/requests.json $T/ && (cd feedback-intake && FEATURES_DATA=$T FEEDBACK_DB=$T/q.db FEEDBACK_ATTACH=$T/a FEEDBACK_OUTBOX=$T/o FEEDBACK_AGENT=0 python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Set task to review with note and evidence, acknowledge the note
